### Resembling the Son
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/resembling-son
Passage: Hebrews 7:2-3
Points:
- Melchizedek's titles as king of righteousness and king of peace foreshadow the Messiah.
- The absence of his genealogy or death in Genesis serves as an Old Testament type of an unending priesthood.
- Jesus transcends this portrait because He truly has an eternal divine nature without beginning or end.
- Melchizedek was presented in Scripture to resemble the Son of God, not the other way around.

### A Better Priesthood
Author: Kim Riddlebarger
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/better-priesthood
Passage: Hebrews 7:1-10
Points:
- Melchizedek's encounter with Abraham points forward in redemptive history to Christ.
- Abraham offering tithes and receiving a blessing demonstrates that Melchizedek holds a higher dignity than the patriarch.
- Because the Levites were in Abraham's loins, the Melchizedekian priesthood is shown to be superior to the Levitical order.
- This greater order finds its ultimate fulfillment in Jesus, who permanently secures our salvation.
